purpose: Controlled subpixel translation test on real HS-100MG microscope crops
source_selection_rule: Use frame_0000.bmp from the pre-existing 50x and 20x 0.5-um displacement sequences; do not select images from model performance.
shift_operator: OpenCV Lanczos-4 translation on normalized float32 intensity with BORDER_REFLECT_101; shifted inputs are stored as 16-bit PNG so the imposed subpixel phase is not collapsed by a second 8-bit quantization
inference_rule: Rerun every learned model on every shifted crop. Use full-crop inference with no tiling so tile-grid phase cannot confound the model comparison.
primary_endpoint: Absolute error of boundary-derived translation at the case-axis-shift cluster grain, in pixels
sharpness_guardrail: Report edge transition width and normalized edge slope so low translation error cannot be credited to feature erasure or excessive smoothing.
aggregation_rule: Circular-feature coordinates are first summarized across the fixed center-nine features; inference comparisons use paired case-axis-shift clusters rather than treating every edge as an independent experiment.
validity_rule: Require at least seven valid center-nine circular features or at least ten valid line edges for a cluster. Reject failed measurements without substitution.
uncertainty_rule: Use paired cluster-level bootstrap intervals with a fixed random seed; report all signed shifts and both magnifications.
